description: Fixed PDF archetype pack covering legal, Form XObject, OCR-heavy, multi-column, table-heavy, long-document, rendering-edge, and garbage-prone cases.

documents.notes: Native digital legal PDF. High-signal founder gate case.

documents.notes: Known garbage-amplification case. If this regresses, the chunker is probably lying again.
